name: Open WebUI
desc: Self-hosted ChatGPT-style interface for local and cloud models.
desc_zh: 自托管的类 ChatGPT 界面，同时接本地与云端模型。
solves: Gives you one private chat interface over your own models, so nothing you write leaves your machine.
solves_zh: 给自己的模型一个统一的私有聊天界面，写的内容不出本机。
best_for: Reaching for it when you run models locally and want a usable chat, RAG and multi-user layer on top.
best_for_zh: 本地跑模型，又需要聊天、检索增强和多用户能力时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：r/LocalLLaMA and r/selfhosted recommendations; Ollama companion-tool threads。来源：https://openwebui.com/
